map.依据分配系数 K、原溶液体积 V₀、每次萃取剂体积 V 与目标回收率，计算所需萃: Computes the required number of extractions and the overall recovery from the partition coefficient K, original solution volume V0, solvent volume V per extraction and the target recovery, and plots recovery against the number of extractions.
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：Math.ceil(Math.log(1-0.999: Core formulas (from the input variables): Math.ceil(Math.log(1-0.999999)/Math.log(q)); Math.ceil(Math.log(1-tFrac)/Math.log(q)); min(max(target,0),99.999)/100
map.💡 单次萃取后原相残留分数 = V₀ / (V₀ + K·V)；n 次后总残留: 💡 Fraction remaining in the original phase after one extraction = V0 / (V0 + K*V); after n extractions the total remainder = [V0/(V0+K*V)]^n; total recovery = 1 - remainder; required count n = lg(1-target) / lg[V0/(V0+K*V)].
map.分配系数 K = 萃取相浓度 / 原相浓度（达平衡时）: Partition coefficient K = concentration in the extract phase / concentration in the original phase (at equilibrium)
map.多次小体积萃取优于单次大体积萃取（相同萃取剂总量）: Several small-volume extractions are better than one large-volume extraction (for the same total solvent volume)
map.📚 深度解析：萃取次数计算（体积法）: 📚 In-depth analysis: extraction count calculation (volumetric method)
map.水相残留分数: Fraction remaining in the aqueous phase
map.目标回收率反算 N: Back-calculated N from the target recovery
map.V0=100 mL、V=25 mL、K=4；单次残留 q=100/(100+4×: V0 = 100 mL, V = 25 mL, K = 4; the single-extraction remainder q = 100/(100+4x25) = 0.5; reaching 99% needs 1-0.5^n >= 0.99, so about 7 extractions.
map.改一次加 7×25=175 mL：单次回收=4×1.75/(1+4×1.75)=: Adding all at once needs 7x25 = 175 mL: single-extraction recovery = 4x1.75/(1+4x1.75) = 87.5%, still below the 99% reached by 7 separate extractions.
map.和分配系数法区别？: How does it differ from the partition coefficient method?
map.同一物理过程两种表达：q=V0/(V0+K·V) 对应剩余分数。: The same physical process expressed two ways: q = V0/(V0+K*V) corresponds to the remaining fraction.
map.权衡溶剂与能耗，常 2~3 次达 85~95% 即停。: Weighing solvent against energy, extraction is usually stopped at 2-3 times when 85-95% is reached.
map.用于液-液萃取工艺计算。依据分配系数 K、原溶液体积、每次萃取剂体积与目标回收率: Used for liquid-liquid extraction process calculation. Based on the partition coefficient K, the original solution volume, the solvent volume per extraction and the target recovery, it computes the required number of extractions and the overall recovery by the partition law and compares it with a single extraction using the same total solvent, showing the advantage of many small extractions.
map.回收率随次数变化曲线: Recovery against number of extractions curve
